_readme: Labelled cold-email replies for `npm run eval:replies` (scripts/eval-replies.ts). Each case is one reply body and the classification a careful human would give it. Fields: id (unique, kebab-case), reply, expected (one of INTERESTED | NOT_INTERESTED | NEEDS_MORE_INFO | NOT_NOW | OUT_OF_OFFICE | REFERRAL), acceptable (optional: other labels a reasonable reviewer could also choose; counted as correct), expectAutoReply (optional boolean the model's isAutoReply must match), urgencyAnyOf (optional; a mismatch is a WARN), critical (optional: a miss here fails the run regardless of overall accuracy — use for compliance/safety cases), tags, note. These seed cases are synthetic but modelled on real field-service replies. Add anonymised real replies over time (strip names, emails, phone numbers, company names), especially any the live system got wrong.
